definition: a person who protects others in their care
description: On a stormy night at an animal rescue camp on the savanna, a young man in an olive ranger uniform stands behind a baby elephant lying on straw under a checked blanket. He lifts a large green tarpaulin higher with both arms to shield the calf, then looks down at it and smiles. Behind him, under a tin roof, other rangers with a lantern look after more young elephants. Lightning flashes near a lone acacia tree under dark clouds and the muddy ground is wet.
